warmup.name: Leg swings
warmup.note: Front-back, then side-side. Warm-up only - this one is not building range, it is getting you into the rest.

warmup.name: Couch stretch
warmup.note: Tuck the pelvis BEFORE you lean, or it becomes a lower-back stretch instead of a hip flexor one.

warmup.name: Seated 90/90 hip switch
warmup.note: Sit on a 5-10 cm plate if the floor is too low. Stay seated - do not kneel through.

warmup.name: 90/90 push-up
warmup.note: Torso down over the front leg to the floor, then back up. Hands assist as much as needed; the goal is the glute lifting you without them.

warmup.name: Side plank
warmup.dose: 5 x 8 s per side, 2-3 s between
warmup.note: Knees or feet - whichever you can hold in a clean line. Stop when the line breaks, not when it burns. Note left vs right the first time.

warmup.name: Clamshell
warmup.note: Heels together, do not let the pelvis roll backward. This is the glute medius drill - side-lying abduction is out, you could not feel it.

warmup.name: Seated good morning, unloaded
warmup.note: At the bench. Hinge from the hip, work toward depth. No bar, not for a long time.

warmup.name: Straddle hold
warmup.note: Knees straight. Kept under 60 s so it does not cost you force on the box squat.

A.session_notes: NEW BLOCK, week 1 of learning. Everything is 5-10% under target and RPE is capped at 7 - the job this week is the patterns, not the loads. Day A is the press-him-overhead day. Two changes that matter: the barbell overhead press is new (front rack, in the rack, bail forward - never behind the neck), and the bench is now ONE heavy triple first while you are fresh, then two paused back-offs. You have never missed a rep at 72.5 kg in four sessions, so this is not a hard set - it is the start of finding where the real ceiling is (~84-87). Calf raises go in the bench rest windows, 3 x 15-20, heels dropped, bottom half only.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press - top set
exercises.notes: NEW. Front rack, in the rack with pins. Ribs down, squeeze glutes, do not lean back. Cap RPE 7 this week.

exercises.name: Barbell Overhead Press - back-off
exercises.notes: Same bar path, lighter. Quality reps.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Bench Press - top set
exercises.notes: Take the full 3 min BEFORE this set. Heaviest set while fresh. Cap RPE 7 this week, then 77.5 next week.

exercises.name: Plate Loaded Bench Press - back-off
exercises.notes: First rep of EACH set paused 2 s on the chest - that is where your reps actually get hard.

exercises.name: Leg Press 45 (partial ROM)
exercises.notes: Moved here from Day C so this day has some lower body. Partial ROM, knee-friendly depth only.

exercises.name: Suitcase Hold (straps)
exercises.notes: 24 kg - the load you already carried on 09-03, so it definitely exists in the gym. Straps on: that is the whole fix for your forearms failing before your core. Stand tall, ribs down, do not lean away from the weight. Go up when 24 feels easy for the full 25 s.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: 6 kg does not exist - dumbbells go in 2.5 kg steps. 5 kg x 15 this week (RPE 7 cap), then 7.5 kg x 12 from week 2. Your old RPE 9-10 at 7.5 was a fatigue-inflated rating, not a real ceiling.

exercises.name: Pec Deck Fly (drop set)
exercises.notes: Drop 25-30% each time on 2.5 kg steps: 42.5 -> 32.5 -> 22.5. Aim 10-12 reps on the FIRST drop. Your old ~15% drops are why the last mini-set collapsed to 4 reps.

B.session_notes: Day B is the lift-him-off-the-ground day. TRAP BAR IS GATED - it does not come in until one full Day B passes with no back symptoms, so this week slot 1 is the 45 degree back extension instead. Weighted dip is new and is bodyweight only this week; it covers triceps, chest and front delts in one slot, which is why there is no pushdown. Hard rules today: RPE 8 cap on the pull-up and the row, and stop the set AND the exercise on any catch or pinch. Seated row stays at 20 kg, your own call after the 09-03 back pull. Calf raises in the row rest windows.

exercises.name: 45 Back Extension (stop at neutral)
exercises.notes: GATE: this is the step before the trap bar. Squeeze glutes, chin tucked, STOP AT NEUTRAL - never arch past straight. Drive it as HIP extension, not a back bend. NOTE for when the trap bar opens: check its bare weight - most hex bars are 25 kg, not 20, so 70 kg means bar + 2x22.5.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Parallel Close Grip - top set
exercises.notes: RPE 8 cap. Stop the set AND the exercise on any catch - this is where you got hurt on 08-21.

exercises.name: Pull-Up Parallel Close Grip - back-off
exercises.notes: Same rule. Stop on any catch.

exercises.name: Machine Seated Row
exercises.notes: 20 kg, not 25. Hard stop at RPE 8. This is the exercise that pulled your back on 09-03.

exercises.name: Weighted Dip
exercises.notes: NEW. Bodyweight only this week. Stop at ~90 degrees of elbow flexion, slight forward lean, DO NOT sink - the bottom is where the shoulder gets loaded badly. Belt comes later.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: 25 kg, not 40. Cable stacks are usually 5 kg steps, so take the nearest plate below 27.5. This is the posture exercise - do not skip it because your upper back feels irritable. If it pinches, prone Y-raise at bodyweight.

exercises.name: Machine Preacher Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: 25 kg start (the stack has 25 and 30, not 27.5). Drop to the next two plates down, roughly 25 -> 17.5 -> 12.5. Aim 10-12 on the first drop. EZ bar curl is gone so you come into this fresh - it should not read 7 reps again.

C.session_notes: Day C is the carry-him day. Box squat is here because nine sessions of 40-55 kg across your upper back produced zero back events - that is what makes the whole carry goal reachable. After the last box squat set, stay standing and hold the bar racked for 30-45 s; that IS the axial exposure, and it replaces the barbell walk your gym is too small for. Pallof press is new: anti-rotation, which is what a squirming child on your shoulders actually demands. Wrist + reverse curl superset goes in the hip thrust rest windows. Outside the gym: carry your son in short timed bouts, 2-3 min, never one long block.

exercises.name: Box Squat (high box) - top set
exercises.notes: Controlled to the box, do not collapse onto it. Cap RPE 7 this week.

exercises.name: Box Squat (high box) - back-off
exercises.notes: AFTER THE LAST SET: stay standing and hold the bar racked on your back for 30-45 s. That is the carry exposure - the gym is too small to walk it.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust - top set
exercises.notes: Your most under-loaded lift - 40 kg on an 81 kg man. This has the most room to grow of anything you do. Ribs down, 2 s squeeze, STOP AT NEUTRAL.

exercises.name: Hip Thrust - back-off
exercises.notes: Same cues. No arching past straight at the top.

exercises.name: Pallof Press (half-kneeling)
exercises.notes: NEW. 10 per side. Half-kneeling so your legs cannot help. Press the handle straight out from your chest and resist the twist. Pick the nearest stack plate to 15 kg - exact load does not matter here, control does.

exercises.name: DB Incline Bench Press
exercises.notes: Back in - this is your chest volume outside Day A.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.notes: Wrist curl + reverse curl superset goes in THESE rest windows, 2 x 10 each.

exercises.name: Lying Incline DB Curl (drop set)
exercises.notes: Per hand, on 2.5 kg steps: 7.5 -> 5 -> 2.5. The only stretch-position bicep movement you do - upper arms hang behind the torso, do not roll the shoulder forward.
